code.selection: First passing public test in genos and tool-assisted; second candidate in direct and no-evidence-gate

memory.selection: One response; exact record value evaluated after inference

reasoning.selection: First passing kernel proof in genos and tool-assisted; second candidate in direct and no-evidence-gate

controls.pairedOrder: Deterministic seeded permutation within each task
controls.development: Only train and dev may be used to debug protocol; holdout never feeds selection or prompt tuning
controls.reproduction: Second frozen campaign with fresh processes and workspaces under an independent operator; independent Python adjudication
controls.budgets: Identical model call, output, context, timeout and checker caps within each pilot. Actual token and latency usage reported; memory controls padded to equal UTF8 byte length, not exact tokens.
controls.toolAssistedBaseline: Also the no-independent-fork ablation; sequential feedback rather than independent candidates.
controls.errors: All failures, invalid output, abstention and timeouts retained in denominator. No score-driven exclusion.
controls.analysis: Paired task differences and exact discordance test; exploratory 8-task cohorts. Reproduction is not pooled as independent additional tasks.
controls.promotion: No benchmark score authorizes production promotion
